description: Noise-profile denoiser with spectral SUBTRACTION: eliminates frequency bands in the sigfile (input 1) that fall below the noisgain-adjusted per-channel maxima found in the noisfile (input 2, a noise-only sample cut from the sigfile), AND subtracts the noise amplitudes from the signal that passes - the gate+subtract big sibling of specnu clean / spec clean. Content-verified: noise-only tail -33.9 dBFS -> digital silence, tonal region kept with the noise floor subtracted (-12.5 -> -12.8 dBFS, slightly drier than the gate-only variants). persist (0-1000 ms) is the minimum time a channel must exceed the noise level to be retained - a chatter guard. Duration follows input 1 (1.9998 from a 2.023 s pair). Deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: The most complete of the family's three denoisers: where spec clean 2 and specnu clean only DELETE below-profile channels, subtract also pulls the noise magnitude out of surviving channels, drying the retained signal itself - the closest thing here to classic broadband spectral subtraction. Workflow: spec cut a noise-only stretch (room tone, hiss bed) from the source analysis, feed it as input 2, start at persist 100 / noisgain 2 and raise noisgain to taste. Longer persist suppresses musical-noise chatter (channels must stay above profile for that long to live) at the cost of eating short quiet details. Pushed hard (noisgain toward 40) it becomes a creative eroder, like its siblings.

persist.description: Minimum time (milliseconds) a channel's signal must exceed the noise level to be retained. CDP-enforced 0 to 1000 ('2000' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (2000.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 1000.000000)'). NOTE the sibling program speclean clean takes this in SECONDS (0.0029-1.0) despite near-identical banner prose.

noisgain.description: Multiplies the noisfile's per-channel maxima before comparison. CDP-enforced 1 to 40 ('50' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[2] Value (50.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 40.000000)'). Banner default 2. A required positional here (contrast spec clean's -g flag).

examples.expected_use: Input 1 = the source analysis, input 2 = a spec cut noise-only stretch from the same source. Below-profile bands deleted, noise floor subtracted from the rest.
Only material that stays well above the profile for 0.4 s survives - dry, stable core.

known_issues: The noisfile (input 2) should be cut from the sigfile (spec cut) to profile the actual noise; both are analysis files.

Sibling divergence pinned: specnu clean (gate-only twin, same banner prose) verified working with ms-persist; speclean clean takes persist in SECONDS (0.0029-1.0 refusal verbatim) and on the same fixture failed to remove the noise-only tail that both specnu variants silenced - speclean is dropped in favour of this entry.
Long persist values eat short quiet details by design (retention requires persistence).
wav input refused; engine auto-PVOCs both inputs. Deterministic (byte-identical reruns).
